map.按多肉品种管理浇水周期，内置常见科属浇水频率数据库，自动根据季节调整（夏休眠/冬: Manage the watering cycle by succulent family, with a built-in database of watering frequency for common families, adjusted automatically by season (summer dormancy, less water in winter), generating the watering queue sorted by urgency.
map.按多肉所属科属（景天科、仙人掌科、百合科等）套用推荐浇水间隔并记录提醒。: Apply the recommended watering interval for the succulent's family (Crassulaceae, Cactaceae, Liliaceae and so on) and record the reminders.
map.结合各科属的养护要点（光照、蜕皮期断水、汁液有毒等）制定差异化浇水策略。: Build differentiated watering strategies around the care points of each family (light, no water during the shedding period, toxic sap and so on).
map.为每盆登记上次浇水日期，自动算出下次浇水日并列出待浇水清单。: Record the date each pot was last watered for and the next watering date is worked out automatically, with a to-do list of plants needing water.
map.：推荐间隔(天)与参考范围：景天科 17（15–20）、仙人掌科 25（20–3: Recommended intervals (days) and reference ranges: Crassulaceae 17 (15-20), Cactaceae 25 (20-30), Liliaceae 12 (10-15), Aizoaceae 20 (15-25), Euphorbiaceae 12 (10-15). Next watering date = last watering date + the recommended interval. Key points per family: Crassulaceae needs plenty of light in the growing season and should be watered only when dry to avoid water in the centre; Cactaceae are extremely drought tolerant and err on the dry side; Liliaceae prefer partial shade and must not have water in the centre; Aizoaceae need a strict dry period during shedding; the sap of Euphorbiaceae is toxic so gloves are needed when repotting or pruning.
map.：景天科桃蛋上次 3 月 1 日浇水，间隔 17 天 → 下次 3 月 18 日: A Crassulaceae (Graptopetalum) last watered on 1 March with a 17 day interval is next due 18 March; a Cactaceae (Echinocactus) last watered 1 March is next due 26 March; an Aizoaceae (Lithops) in the shedding period is not watered on a cycle and needs a strict dry period until the old skin dries up.
map.和按品种名的浇水周期有什么区别？: How does this differ from the watering cycle by species name?
map.本工具按科属给出统一推荐值与范围，适合混栽或不记得具体种名的情况；已知品种名时用: This page gives a single recommended value and range per family, which suits mixed plantings or when you cannot remember the exact species name; if you know the species name, the per-species frequency table (split by season) is more precise.
map.周期到了但盆土还湿怎么办？: The cycle has come round but the soil is still wet, what do I do?
map.周期为参考值，实际以盆土干透为准；通风差、阴雨天或低温时应延后浇水，宁干勿湿是多: The cycle is a reference value; in practice go by when the soil has dried out. With poor ventilation, in rainy weather or at low temperatures you should delay watering, and erring on the dry side is the general rule for succulents.
